_comment: Relay RLN smoke on a local LEZ chain: 1 bootstrap (native, store; no RLN, so it relays and stores anything),
2 validating delivery-module members with an RLN membership, 1 validating member without one that also sends,
and 1 sender with a membership. The "rln" section adds the LEZ sequencer and the registry setup.
./harness.sh build with this manifest first (RLN modules, LEZ tools and sequencer), then
HARNESS_MANIFEST=examples/rln-smoke.json COLLECT_LOGS=all ./harness.sh run out/collect/rln-smoke
Expect: every message of the member sender received by all; every send of the one without a membership a messageError.
Pinned to the logos-delivery commit this case was recorded on (overrides.logos-delivery);
drop that override and the image to run it on what the module's lock names.
Override without editing this file:
DELIVERY_MODULE_REF=<branch|tag|full-sha>  DELIVERY_MODULE_REV=<full-sha>
and likewise DELIVERY_*, LIBP2P_MODULE_*, OPENMETRICS_MODULE_*,
LOGOSCORE_CLI_* for the dependencies this module otherwise chooses.
A branch is not a pin: out/resolved.json records the commit it resolved to.
Only what the chosen module ref cannot supply, or what we deliberately
differ on. master pins libp2p_module, openmetrics-module and
logos-delivery in its flake lock, so those are derived.
logos-logoscore-cli is not the module's own input: its lock only carries
copies pulled in by other inputs (libp2p_module, logos-test-modules), and
its docker-compose runs yet another. The harness keeps running 665ac28b,
the version every recorded run used. `harness.sh resolve` shows each source.
libp2p_module v1.1.1: the RLN allocation client needs 1.1.0 or later.
